title: Campaign choreography and stakeholder alignment playbook for multi-channel product rollout
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Author a single-source playbook that coordinates blog, email, social, webinar and release notes for the upcoming product rollout. Focus on timing windows across time zones, content freeze and approval gates, and dependencies with engineering (runtime release), design (assets), marketing (creative + paid), and support (triage playbook). Deliverables: channel schedule CSV, release-notes schema and samples, stakeholder RACI, pre/post measurement plan, and a reusable calendar template for future launches.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Finalized channel schedule with publish timestamps for blog/email/social/webinar and localized send windows.
2) Release notes in the canonical schema posted to /docs/release-notes and linked in the blog.
3) All creative assets approved by design and uploaded to the shared drive.
4) Dry-run completed for the webinar with ops checklist and fallback recording ready.
5) Support playbook published with escalation contacts and suggested responses.
6) Cross-team kickoff and pre-launch sign-off recorded in the playbook.

notes: Decision: Use one canonical release-notes schema (short summary, impact, migration notes, docs links) to avoid fragmentation across channels.
Trade-off: Narrow send windows reduce overlap but compress approvals; decided to keep two localized waves (EMEA/US+APAC) to balance coverage and approval time.
Fallback: If runtime perf signoff misses the deadline, shift to staged rollout using feature gating + canary to Dedicated customers only, and delay public blog by 72 hours.
Measurement plan: Track signups from blog, email CTR, webinar registrations, and runtime error-rate post-launch (1h/24h/7d buckets).
